quarterly_data.signal: As of May 28, 2026, the transaction price allocated to Micron's remaining performance obligations was approximately $5 billion, of which $422 million had been recognized as contract liabilities (primarily customer deposits under strategic customer agreements); about one-third is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next twelve months. Micron states this disclosure is based on minimum committed volumes and minimum pricing, is not expected to be indicative of future revenue under these contracts, and excludes agreements without fixed pricing or price bands and contracts with an original term of one year or less (the strategic customer agreements are take-or-pay with binding volume commitments). Remaining performance obligations were not material as of August 28, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO ~$5 billion as of May 28, 2026, on a minimum committed volume and minimum pricing basis ($422 million recognized as contract liabilities); ~one-third over the next twelve months

quarterly_data.signal: For the first nine months of fiscal 2026, expenditures for property, plant and equipment were $19.60 billion, partially offset by $2.99 billion of government incentive proceeds (versus $10.20 billion and $1.29 billion a year earlier). Purchase obligations for property, plant and equipment were approximately $2.93 billion as of May 28, 2026, substantially all expected to be paid within one year.
quarterly_data.figure: 9M FY2026 PP&E expenditures $19.60 billion (vs $10.20 billion); PP&E purchase obligations ~$2.93 billion (May 28, 2026)
